identity.title: Say It With Your Body
identity.styleSentence: A slow, confident 136 BPM R&B anthem with ultra-deep sub-bass, cinematic strings, and intimate call-and-response vocals, blending modern alternative R&B with late-night hip-hop production for a luxurious, immersive nightclub vibe.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
(Female, whisper)
Closer...
No words...
Come here...
(Bass drops)
[Verse 1 — Male]
Different streets...
Different names...
Different skies...
Same heartbeat...
You smile...
I don't know what to say...
But somehow...
You already know...
[Pre-Chorus — Female]
Your language...
Mine too...
Still...
We're moving...
Like we always knew...
[Chorus]
(Both)
Say it with your body...
Closer...
Say it with your body...
Slower...
Say it with your body...
Move me...
Say it with your body...
Hold me...
Say it with your body, baby...
Don't say maybe...
Just...
Say it with your body...
[Verse 2 — Female]
Every city's got another rhythm...
Every heartbeat finds another home...
You reach for me...
I answer back...
No translation on this road...
[Male]
One small step...
One slow sway...
That's enough...
To tell me everything...
[Pre-Chorus]
(Together)
No dictionary...
No explanation...
Just the music...
And the vibration...
[Drop]
(Instrumental)
Deep sub...
Cello...
Tiny sax response...
Bass wobble...
Strings...
Breathing...
[Chorus 2]
Say it with your body...
Closer...
Say it with your body...
Tighter...
Say it with your body...
Move me...
Say it with your body...
Touch me...
Say it with your body, baby...
Just say it with your body...
[Bridge]
(Female)
When the words don't reach...
(Male)
I'll meet you halfway...
(Female)
When the silence speaks...
(Male)
I'll feel what you say...
(Together)
From Brooklyn...
To Manila...
To Lagos...
To Saigon...
Every heartbeat...
Speaks the same...
[Final Chorus]
Say it with your body...
Slowly...
Say it with your body...
Hold me...
Say it with your body...
Show me...
Say it with your body...
Know me...
Say it with your body, baby...
Make me feel...
Every little heartbeat...
Say it with your body...
Just...
Say it with your body...
[Outro]
(Female whisper over fading cello and sub-bass)
You never had to say a word...
I heard you...

analysis.summary: A sensual and cinematic R&B anthem exploring intimacy and connection through physical and emotional language, emphasizing the power of nonverbal communication in a global, romantic journey.

keywords.imageryPrompt: A dimly lit room with soft shadows, a couple slowly moving in sync, their bodies close, the air thick with unspoken emotion.
Two people whispering in a quiet, moonlit park, the sound of their breaths blending with the rustle of leaves.
A sweeping aerial view of a city at night, neon lights reflecting on rain-slicked streets, a lone figure walking through the glow.
A deep bass note echoing through a dark nightclub, the walls shimmering with light, bodies swaying in unison.
Two heartbeats in sync, glowing softly in the dark, surrounded by a field of stars and silence.
A dancer in a spotlight, their body flowing with emotion, the music guiding every step with a magnetic pull.
A warm embrace in a rainstorm, the sound of thunder echoing softly as the world fades away.
A doorway opening to a vast, glowing landscape, the light revealing hidden paths and unspoken truths.
A person standing in a field of glowing flowers, the petals trembling with emotion as the wind carries their feelings.
